tools.name: hexnode_list_devices
tools.description: List enrolled devices with OS, model, enrollment status, last-reported time and compliance. Start here to find device ids. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devices/.

tools.name: hexnode_get_device
tools.description: Get full details of one device: hardware, OS, network, owner, installed apps, applied policies and device groups. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_device_policies
tools.description: List the policies applied to one device, with their versions. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/policies/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_device_apps
tools.description: List the apps installed on one device, with version, status and managed flag. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/applications/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_device_locations
tools.description: List the locations a device reported over time (newest first as the portal returns them). Only with location tracking enabled. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/locations/.

tools.name: hexnode_get_action_status
tools.description: Show the status of actions sent to one device (for example a lock, a restart or an app install), to confirm that it ran. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/action_status/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_users
tools.description: List users of the portal with their enrollment state and devices. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/users/.

tools.name: hexnode_get_user
tools.description: Get one user's details, including contact fields and the user's groups. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/users/{id}/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_device_groups
tools.description: List all device groups. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devicegroups/.

tools.name: hexnode_get_device_group
tools.description: Get one device group with its member devices. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/devicegroups/{id}/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_policies
tools.description: List all policies of the portal (name, version, platforms). Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/policy/.

tools.name: hexnode_get_policy
tools.description: Get the full details of one policy, including its settings. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/policy/{id}/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_apps
tools.description: List apps in the portal's app library (store, web or enterprise apps), filterable by platform. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/applications/.

tools.name: hexnode_get_app
tools.description: Get the details of one app in the portal's library, including its identifier and version. Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/applications/{id}/.

tools.name: hexnode_list_app_groups
tools.description: List app groups (bundles of apps that are deployed together). Hexnode API: GET /api/v1/appgroups/.

tools.name: hexnode_scan_device
tools.description: Ask devices to report their inventory now (a scan). Safe to repeat. Hexnode API: POST /api/v1/actions/scan_device/.

tools.name: hexnode_install_application
tools.description: Install one or more apps from the portal's library on devices or device groups. Use hexnode_list_apps to find app ids. Hexnode API: POST /api/v1/actions/install_applications/.

tools.name: hexnode_restart_device
tools.description: Restart devices now. This interrupts the user's work and unsaved data can be lost. Set confirm to true to run it. Hexnode API: POST /api/v1/actions/reboot/.

tools.name: hexnode_lock_device
tools.description: Lock devices now, with an optional message on the screen. iOS and Android users unlock with their device passcode. Intel Macs need a 6-digit system_lock_pin to unlock. Set confirm to true to run it. Hexnode API: POST /api/v1/actions/lock_devices/.
